mode
states
ᛉ the world-tree worlds read live from the backend API — one vine open at a time

what the tree means

  • world list read live from the backend service API (/api/namespaces) — never hardcoded; lantern seats assigned by curated id, djb2-hashed for unknown worlds
  • trunk the tree display's root — grows from the panel floor
  • lantern one namespace (a world) — the painted lantern carries its icon
  • berries namespace stats: succeeded · running · failed
  • vine one world open at a time — its job cards hang along a curved vine that extends as work grows
  • task pips beneath a collapsed lantern, one small icon per task; expanding pops them down the strand, each landing on its job's anchor
  • anchor icon each job's status sigil seats ON the vine where its card ties on — the title box carries text only, no icon inside
  • job card name, title, issue #, agent — actions are icon-only (📌 ✕, tooltip explains), clasping the bottom border flush right
  • spores drift gold while the WS feed is live

job states

  • running moon-blue, breathing glow
  • succeeded steady moss-green
  • failed ember flicker
  • pending dim, unhatched
  • selected teal ring on leaf + lantern
  • purged the leaf falls from its shoot

try it

  • hover a lantern world name + full stats line
  • click a lantern its vine grows; the last one retracts
  • click a card its session opens in a tab (or focuses + refreshes)
  • pin / cancel act right on the card — no popups anywhere
  • long vine many jobs? the vine extends and the panel scrolls
  • cancel the card falls from the vine, its tab closes
